maddeler.e:
يسلا (form I)
# يَسُلَّا (yasullā) /ja.sul.laː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of سَلَّ (salla)
# يُسَلَّا (yusallā) /ju.sal.laː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of سَلَّ (salla) and سُلَّ (sulla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
